subject: StandaloneMmPkg: Ensure section length alignment
reasons: Neighboring commit f3f585bd42 (ArmPkg/ArmStandaloneMmCoreEntryPoint) applies the exact same pattern: replacing SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize with ALIGN_VALUE(SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize, SectionAlignment) in permission-update calls
The two commits form a series by the same author with identical commit messages and identical transformation applied to different packages
Clear structural match-and-replace: calls to permission updater functions that take raw VirtualSize should be wrapped with ALIGN_VALUE
candidate_pattern: Replace permission updater calls: TextUpdater/ReadOnlyUpdater/NoExecUpdater/ReadWriteUpdater(Base, SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize) -> same(Base, ALIGN_VALUE(SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize, SectionAlignment))
